about: printer_1's slicer profile: an Ender 3 (2018) with a 0.4 mm nozzle and a TH3D EZABL probe, on Marlin TH3D UFW 2.94a. It starts from OrcaSlicer's own Creality Ender-3 profiles, read from the installed release at each slice (none is copied here), and holds what the bench measured. Each value says where it came from. apothecary/slicer/profiles.py reads it.

start.source: the owner's decision of 2026-10-10 (docs/plans/slicer-2026-10-10.md): the start of a print is composed from modules as they are wanted; homing, with no levelling -- stored-mesh (M420 S1 after G28) or probe-each-print (G29) is named here by a person after the bench's levelling boxes (docs/validation/2026-11-07-machine-setup.md), and a measured first-layer offset is a stub

filament.source: the owner's decision of 2026-10-10 (docs/plans/slicer-2026-10-10.md): the printer's one filament, Creality Generic PLA, named below; choosing another is a stub

printable_area.source: the build volume: 220 x 220 mm, Creality's published figure (parts/ender3/ender3.scad, the part's BUILD) and the bench's pinned printer_1 (docs/validation/2026-09-20-ender-bench.md: GET /firmware/printers/where, volume 220 x 220 x 250)

printable_height.source: the build volume: 250 mm high, from the same two

gcode_flavor.source: the firmware the bench identified: Marlin TH3D UFW 2.94a (docs/validation/2026-09-20-ender-bench.md, M115)

z_offset.source: the bed's offset the bench measured, M851 Z-3.15 with X-44 Y-10 (docs/validation/2026-09-20-ender-bench.md), is the probe's, kept in the board's EEPROM and applied by the firmware itself when the start G-code's G28 homes Z with the probe
z_offset.note: the slicer adds nothing: adding -3.15 here would apply it a second time and drive the nozzle into the bed

firmware.value: Marlin TH3D UFW 2.94a, MACHINE_TYPE TH3D EZABL, one extruder
firmware.used: gcode_flavor marlin; the G-code is checked against the Print card's refused codes as an upload is

build_volume.source: Creality's published figure (parts/ender3, BUILD) and the bench's pin of printer_1 (GET /firmware/printers/where)

probe_offset.used: held, and nothing is applied: the firmware applies it when G28 homes Z with the probe, so z_offset stays 0; the start piece probe-each-print needs it held here; a measured first-layer offset is the start piece first-layer-offset, a stub

bed_mesh.source: docs/validation/2026-09-20-ender-bench.md: M420 V, the stored mesh as it was last probed
bed_mesh.used: held, and nothing is applied: the start is home alone; the start piece stored-mesh (M420 S1 after G28) is refused while the board's newest reading is not a probe under mesh_range_bound, and the bench says to tram the bed before trusting it

mesh_range_bound.source: docs/validation/2026-11-07-machine-setup.md, the Ender's Recommendations, 1: after the bed is trammed, Probe bed is expected to find a range under 0.3 mm, and what is left is the plate's bow, which a mesh corrects and tramming cannot; a bed further out is trammed, not corrected
mesh_range_bound.used: the start piece stored-mesh: chosen only while the newest bed reading of the printer's board is a probe whose range is under this, else refused with the reason, and the start stays home
